items.source_en:
Reliant Medical
Project: Sumeria
Employee ID: 151697

Reliant Medical is pleased to welcome you onto Project Sumeria, the Galaxy largest and most pertinent backup of medicinal plants. Our goal is to protect and maintain the well-being of thousands of years of studies in botany and medicine. You have been chosen to complete a 24-month tenure, where you will be the sole and primary caretaker of the entire facility. 

You have shown excellence in your knowledge of botany and expertise in engineering. It is your duty not only to grow and care for the plants, but maintain and upkeep the irrigation droids and water filtration system. We appreciate the sacrifice and selflessness it will take to ensure the Galaxy remain a healthy and safe place.
